correctness.rationale: I checked the symmetric uniform-stationary SLEM objective ||Q−J_m||_2. For noncomplete H a missing off-diagonal Q_ij forces |(Q−J)ij|=1/m; the centered basis vectors yield rho(H)>=1/(m−1). An explicit hub-edge weight 1/m and outer block (m−1)Q/m has radial eigenvalue −1/m and other eigenvalues (m−1)/m times nontrivial Q eigenvalues, proving universal <=; complete H is handled by J. For vertex-transitive H, average any feasible cone matrix over Aut(H): all hub edges equal b<=1/m; the zero-sum outer block is (1−b)Q_b, yielding rho(P)>= (1−b)rho(Q_b)>= (m−1)rho(H)/m. Disconnected H retains rho(H)=1. The four-path lower bound rho(P4)=sqrt2/2 follows from reflection modes; I independently exactly recomputed the stated five-state witness characteristic polynomial x(40x²−2x−7)(200x²−10x−33)/8000, with SLEM (1+sqrt281)/40≈0.444076<3sqrt2/8. The proof, not graph samples, covers every finite graph.
